activity_statements.statement: manages, franchises, and in some cases owns hotels across 70+ countries under 30+ brands spanning luxury (Park Hyatt, Andaz), full-service (Hyatt Regency, Grand Hyatt), and select-service (Hyatt Place, Hyatt House) tiers
operates the World of Hyatt loyalty program enabling guests to earn and redeem points across its global hotel portfolio
earns fees from hotel management contracts and franchise agreements under an asset-light operating model
provides meeting, conference, and events infrastructure at large-format hotels for corporate and association groups

name_reality_gap: none — Hyatt is straightforwardly a hotel company.
extraction_notes: Hyatt.com and all subpages timed out during crawl (multiple 504 errors). Profile built from general public knowledge of Hyatt as a hotel company. Confidence lowered significantly. Brand list and business model are well-established public facts.
